content: {"steps": [{"tool": "get_transcript", "args": {"vendor_id": "V002"}}, {"tool": "get_application", "args": {"vendor_id": "V002"}}, {"tool": "get_metrics", "args": {"vendor_id": "V002"}}], "final": {"commitments": [{"term": "margin_pct", "offered": 21, "transcript_quote": "No, 21 is my floor on the treats.", "turn": 6}, {"term": "payment_days", "offered": 30, "transcript_quote": "But I can do 30 days if the order is confirmed in writing this week.", "turn": 8}, {"term": "moq", "offered": 500, "transcript_quote": "I can bring it down to 500 units in total for the first order, split across the SKUs you list.", "turn": 10}, {"term": "marketing_inr", "offered": 50000, "transcript_quote": "We can raise that to 50,000 rupees for the launch month, to be used on sponsored listings and sampling.", "turn": 12}, {"term": "launch_discount_pct", "offered": 5, "transcript_quote": "I can give a 5 percent launch discount for the first 30 days.", "turn": 14}, {"term": "returns", "offered": 7, "transcript_quote": "Defect returns within 7 days stay as they are.", "turn": 16}], "refusals": [{"term": "margin_pct", "transcript_quote": "No, 21 is my floor on the treats.", "turn": 6, "note": "Refused buyer request to go to 24 percent on treats"}, {"term": "returns", "transcript_quote": "I am sorry, I cannot accept returns of unsold stock.", "turn": 16, "note": "Refused sale-or-return on unsold stock after 90 days; defect returns within 7 days only"}], "counter_offer": {"asks": ["Improve treats margin from 21 percent toward our 35 percent target", "Confirm guaranteed margin on litter without volume condition"], "email_draft": "Hi Priya, Thank you for the discussion. Confirming what was agreed: 21 percent margin on treats, 30 days payment with order confirmed in writing this week, 500 units total first-order MOQ split across SKUs we list, 50,000 rupees launch marketing support for the launch month, 5 percent launch discount for the first 30 days, and defect returns within 7 days only with no sale-or-return. On the remaining gap, please revisit the treats margin toward our 35 percent target and confirm a guaranteed margin on litter. The conditional structure of 15 percent base plus 20 percent marketing support if we sell 2,000 units in 90 days does not work for a new brand. Please confirm by Friday. Best regards."}}}
